points: Pour the water for the rice (see pantry for amount) into a medium saucepan with a tight-fitting lid.
Stir in the rice and ¼ tsp salt and bring to the boil. Once boiling, turn the heat down to medium and cover with the lid.
Leave to cook for 10 mins, then remove the pan from the heat (still covered) and leave to the side for another 10 mins or until ready to serve (the rice will continue to cook in its own steam).
steps.title: Boil the Rice

points: Meanwhile, halve, peel and chop the onion into small pieces.
Cut the tomato into 2cm chunks.
Thinly slice the chilli (see ingredients for amount).
Peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
steps.title: Prep the Veg

points: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large saucepan on medium-high heat.
Once hot, add the onion, season with salt and pepper and fry, stirring occasionally, until golden and softened, 6-8 mins. Stir in the tomato halfway through frying.
Add in the garlic, ginger puree, Goan style curry paste and half the chilli (add less if you'd prefer things milder) and fry for a further min until fragrant.
Once fragrant, stir in the coconut milk and simmer, 2-3 mins.
steps.title: Build the Flavour

points: Meanwhile, roughly chop the coriander (stalks and all).
Cut the lime into wedges.
Pat the basa dry with kitchen paper and cut the basa into 4cm pieces.
Once the curry has simmered, add the sauce to a blender and blend on high until smooth. Return the now smooth curry to the saucepan and bring to a boil.

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw fish.

steps.title: Finish the Prep

points: Lower the heat to medium and add the basa pieces to the sauce then stir to coat. Season with salt and pepper. Simmer gently until the fish is cooked, 5-8 mins.
Once the basa has simmered, add the spinach to the pan a handful at a time until wilted and piping hot, 1-2 mins.
Remove from the heat and stir in half the coriander and a good squeeze of lime juice.
Season with salt and pepper.

notes.text: The fish is cooked when opaque in the middle.

steps.title: All Together Now

points: Share the rice between your serving bowls.
Spoon over the Goan style fish curry.
Sprinkle over the remaining coriander and chilli to finish. Serve with any remaining lime wedges for squeezing over.
steps.title: Serve
